'''Moshi Bar''' was a tavern located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was owned by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Volpai/Legends|Volpai]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] named [[Tiggs Leo/Legends|Tiggs Leo]].

==History==
{{Quote|Well, I hope we have better luck here. This is the fifth scum bucket drinking hole we've been to.|Ahsoka Tano, to Plo Koon|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Date">{{FactFile2014|35|21 BBY 9-12|Boba Fett's Revenge}}</ref> Moshi Bar was visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] searching for information on [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. A fight was going to erupt in the tavern due to Ahsoka's eavesdropping, but was prevented from Ahsoka's distraction and Leo's reluctance for his bar to be damaged.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moshi Bar first appeared in "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," the twenty second episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]]. Although it went unidentified in its sole appearance,<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> the tavern was identified as Moshi Bar in concept art available on the Blu-ray version of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]].<ref name="The Complete Season Two">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]</ref>
